scope: Diagnostic Phase 3 test-manifest (n_test=28) after U-Net scoring fix
run_note: First U-Net pass produced NaN scores (invalid AUC=1.0); corrected to checkpoint normalization. Logged in run_log.txt.

findings.claim: Deep U-Net does not earn its complexity on this corpus
findings.evidence: B4 test ROC-AUC 0.733 < B2 logreg 0.800 and only slightly above slope 0.694; ΔAUC vs slope CI crosses 0
findings.label: VERIFIED

findings.evidence: B4 and B5 metrics identical to floating precision; channels 100% nodata corpus-wide
findings.label: VERIFIED

findings.evidence: predict-all-positive on masked test pixels F1≈0.778 vs foundation-reported pixel F1 0.818
findings.label: VERIFIED

findings.claim: No candidate passes protocol acceptance even diagnostically
findings.evidence: All FAIL criterion A (ΔAUC CI vs slope) and/or B/C
findings.label: VERIFIED
